# July 2026

The busiest month of the year: Mom's care arrangement changed course, the kitchen hit its first surprise, and we were away for nine days in the middle of it.

## Mom's care: from the day program to an aide

The Senior Center program ended on 3 July after Mom attended 9 of 34 planned days ([[adult-day-program-ended-2026-07-03|day program ended]]). We read it as a mismatch with what she had asked for, help with the house, and put the next step off until Claire and Mom could both be part of it. The family call on 26 July agreed a three-month Greywillow aide trial from 3 August, with the cost split Mom insisted on and a review on 2 November ([[family-care-call-2026-07-26|family care call]]). Claire's case for assisted living was recorded as a position with its reasons, not as an objection. Greywillow's intake visit followed on 29 July ([[greywillow-intake-visit-2026-07-29|intake visit]]).

## Kitchen: rot, and money

The subfloor rot under the old dishwasher became the first change order on 8 July, taken as the smaller repair rather than a full overlay ([[subfloor-rot-change-order-2026-07-08|subfloor change order]]). That started the question of how to fund an overrun, still open at month end with the emergency fund as the leading option ([[how-should-we-fund-the-renovation-overrun|funding the overrun]]). The cabinet date of 20 July passed without cabinets, as Birchwell had warned ([[cabinet-delivery-slip-2026-07-20|cabinet slip]]).

## Halvane Peaks

We closed up the house on the usual routine and left on 11 July, with Mom at Claire's. The family debrief on 25 July is in [[halvane-peaks-trip-debrief-2026-07-25|trip debrief]]; the trip came in over budget, as [[halvane-peaks-trip-2026|the trip project]] records.
